subject.title: Allow up to six Overview providers

question: Should existing installations with no explicit Overview-provider selection retain the established three-provider fallback, or should this release intentionally expand their implicit selection to six?
rationale: The persisted absence of a selection currently carries user-visible behavior, and changing the shared cap alters that behavior on upgrade; tests alone cannot choose the intended product contract.

options.title: Preserve legacy upgrades
options.body: Keep the three-provider fallback for prior installations without a saved selection, while permitting six after an explicit choice or for an intentionally defined fresh-install default.

options.title: Adopt six on upgrade
options.body: Intentionally migrate the legacy empty state to six and document the expanded Overview as an upgrade-visible default change with focused migration coverage.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy upgrades
recommendation.body: Keep the three-provider fallback for prior installations without a saved selection, while permitting six after an explicit choice or for an intentionally defined fresh-install default.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent direct contribution to the affected Overview menu coverage makes this the strongest available routing candidate.
